context.summary: A compact, fortified highland mining outpost established in the shadow of the Northern Ribs to mine magnetite iron and quarry dark slate.
context.host_region_lore: Once pastoral sheep-walks and lonely bluffs, the highlands have unified under the High Thane of Dun Kestrel into a fortified domain of white-chalk bastions, limestone quarries, terraced barley fields, and disciplined border companies.
context.scale_profile: Small / Compact (Fledgling cluster. Small structural footprint with a high proportion of surrounding natural terrain, open yards, and frontier buffer.)

perimeters.description: Transition into host region (The Undulating Downs — Hills).
perimeters.lore: Once pastoral sheep-walks and lonely bluffs, the highlands have unified under the High Thane of Dun Kestrel into a fortified domain of white-chalk bastions, limestone quarries, terraced barley fields, and disciplined border companies.

approaches.road_lore: A steep, graded wagon-track of crushed limestone and basalt ballast linking the high citadel of Dun Kestrel with the northern iron mines of Ironcrest.
approaches.destination_lore: Elevated from a pastoral hill-fort into the sovereign stone citadel of the western highlands. Encircled by cyclopean chalk-ashlar ramparts, high beacon towers, and cavernous grain vaults, Dun Kestrel now commands the sheep-walks, quarries, and reclaimed polders of the downs as an equal rival to the River Throne.

context.world_relations: Ironcrest functions as the primary material engine for Dun Kestrel, supplying dark slate for citadel roofing and rich magnetite iron for arms, armor, and structural ironwork along the steep Iron-Trace wagon road.
context.architectural_rationale: The outpost is tightly enclosed by chalk-ashlar and timber palisades built into the mountain base. Mining shafts and slate benches press directly against the northern rock face, while smelting kilns, barracks, and wagon yards surround a central courtyard connected directly to the southern gatehouse and the Iron-Trace road.

0.name: Frontier Buffer & Chalk Bluffs
0.lore: Unzoned limestone bluffs and rolling downs surrounding the outpost, marked by wild sheep-walks and scree slopes.

1.name: Redoubt Staging Courtyard
1.lore: A graveled, timber-braced yard where heavy ore wagons are loaded, weighed, and prepared for transit along the Iron-Trace.

2.name: Magnetite Incline & Slate Quarry
2.lore: Shored shaft mouths and quarry terraces extracting dark slate slabs and rich magnetite veins from the roots of the Northern Ribs.

3.name: Assay Kilns & Smelting Hearth
3.lore: High-heat stone furnaces and blacksmith hearths where magnetite ore is assayed and iron quarrying tools are forged.

4.name: Garrison Hold & Iron Gatehouse
4.lore: A fortified chalk-ashlar gatehouse and timber barracks housing the High Thane's border guards and mining overseers.

magnetite_mine_shaft.name: Northern Ribs Mine Incline
magnetite_mine_shaft.lore: A timber-shored shaft driving deep into the highland ridge to extract high-purity magnetite iron for Dun Kestrel.

slate_quarry_saw.name: Highland Slate Works
slate_quarry_saw.lore: Open cutting benches and wedge-frames where dark slate is split into roofing shingles and structural slabs for the citadel.

smelting_hearth.name: Assay Kiln & Tool Smithy
smelting_hearth.lore: Draft-boosted masonry furnaces used to test iron ore purity and repair heavy steel drills, picks, and wagon axles.

garrison_barracks.name: Border Company Quarters
garrison_barracks.lore: Reinforced chalk-ashlar barracks providing quarters and armaments for the disciplined guards stationed by the High Thane.

wagon_depot.name: Iron-Trace Wagon Yard
wagon_depot.lore: A heavy-timber staging barn where ballast wagons and draft oxen assemble before hauling iron and slate south.

iron_gatehouse.name: The South Iron Gatehouse
iron_gatehouse.lore: A thick chalk-and-timber barrier controlling access between the Iron-Trace wagon road and the interior mine yard.
